title: MellyCore Loop Run Ledger
description: Contract for a single run of a single loop. The ledger is the ONLY input the circuit breaker trusts. scripts/loop_ops/guard.py reads a ledger and returns a decision deterministically, without calling a model. Enforced in plain Python by scripts/loop_ops/validators.py, not by a JSON Schema library.

run_id.description: For a ledger intended for persistence via `persist-run`, the canonical form is <loop-id>--<UTC timestamp>--<12 lowercase hex characters>, e.g. project-health--20260715T180000Z--a1b2c3d4e5f6, matching the pattern below. Guard-only ledgers used for local dry runs are not required to match this pattern -- it is enforced only at the point persist-run constructs a filesystem path from it, by scripts/loop_ops/persist.py, not here.

completed_at.description: Required only for a ledger intended for persistence via persist-run (not by guard, which does not read this field). Must not be earlier than started_at, and must not be after the persist action's own wall clock.

repository.description: Required only for persistence. The repository the run happened against, as declared by whoever produced the ledger. A mismatch against the repository persist-run is actually running in is recorded in the persisted evidence, not blocked -- historical evidence from elsewhere is still real evidence.

branch.description: Required only for persistence. The branch the run happened against, as declared by whoever produced the ledger. Recorded and compared against the current branch at persist time; a mismatch is recorded, not blocking.

head_sha.description: Required only for persistence. The full commit SHA the run happened against, as declared by whoever produced the ledger. Recorded and compared against the current HEAD at persist time; a mismatch is recorded, not blocking. Distinct from the CLI's own --expected-head flag, which must match the current HEAD exactly or persistence is refused.

outcome.description: Required only for persistence. The run's own top-level outcome, matching the vocabulary already used by LOOP_STATE_SCHEMA.json's run_history[].outcome.

repository_mutation_count.description: Required only for persistence. Must be 0 for any Phase 1 REPORT_ONLY loop; a nonzero value is refused by persist-run, since no loop may write to the repository in Phase 1.

remote_action_count.description: Required only for persistence. Must be 0 for any Phase 1 REPORT_ONLY loop; a nonzero value is refused by persist-run, since no loop may push, comment, or otherwise reach a remote in Phase 1.

status_before.description: Lifecycle state the loop was in before this run. The guard checks status_before -> status_after against the allowed transition map.

status_after.description: Lifecycle state the loop intends to move to. A forbidden transition is BLOCK_INVALID_STATE.

iterations.description: Append-only. One entry per attempt. Never rewritten to hide a failure.

index.description: 1-based attempt counter. Must be strictly increasing.

error_signature.description: Normalized error identity for stagnation detection. Required when outcome is failure. Must not contain secrets, paths with credentials, or raw provider output.

progress_marker.description: What this attempt actually achieved. Unchanged marker across attempts means no progress.

tokens.description: MEASURED token usage for this attempt, when a real run recorded it. Never populate this with an estimate; estimates belong to the estimate-cost command and are labelled as such. The 'total' field is conditional on 'measured', corrected by docs/research/LOOP_STATE_PERSISTENCE_REVIEW_001.md Section 5: when measured is true, total is required and must be a non-negative integer (zero is a valid measured value, distinct from 'not measured'). When measured is false, total must be null or absent -- never a number, including zero -- because 'not measured' and 'measured, and it was zero' must stay distinguishable. This conditional rule is expressed below via if/then for readability; it is enforced in Python by scripts/loop_ops/registry.py::_parse_iteration, not by a JSON Schema library.

measured.description: Must be true for the value to count toward budget enforcement. The guard keys 'unmeasured' off this flag alone, never off whether 'total' happens to be present.

verifier.description: Independent verification result. The verifier must not be the same agent that produced the work.

daily_tokens_used.description: MEASURED tokens already spent by this loop today, if tracked. Null means unknown; the guard then reports the daily budget as unenforceable rather than pretending it passed.

kill_switch_engaged.description: Set true when the global kill switch file is present. The guard treats this as an immediate halt.
